external.name: memo watch
external.description: Default command. Continuously monitors file changes and updates .memo/index. Use --skip-scan to skip initial full scan when index is already up-to-date.

external.name: memo scan
external.description: One-shot mode: performs full scan, triggers analysis, then exits. Useful for CI/CD pipelines, pre-commit hooks, or initial setup.

external.name: memo mcp
external.description: Starts MCP (Model Context Protocol) server over stdio. Provides read-only JSON path query access to .memo/index files. Requires existing index (run watch/scan first).

external.name: --version
external.description: Prints the version string and exits. Version is injected at build time via ldflags.

external.name: -p/--path
external.params: string: path to directory (default: current working directory)
external.description: Global flag specifying the target directory. Works with all subcommands.

external.name: --log-level
external.params: string: error, notice, info, or debug
external.description: Global flag that overrides log level from config file.

external.name: config.yaml
external.params: YAML file with: log_level, agent.api_key, agent.model, watch.ignore_patterns, watch.debounce_ms, watch.max_wait_ms
external.description: Main configuration file. Agent settings are optional (uses kimi defaults). Watch settings control file monitoring behavior.

external.name: .memo/index/*.json
external.params: JSON files: arch.json, interface.json, stories.json, issues.json
external.description: Output directory containing documentation files maintained by the AI agent. Created automatically on first run with empty structures.

external.name: .memo/mcp.json
external.params: JSON file with MCP server configurations
external.description: Local MCP configuration file for watcher sessions. Created automatically to prevent loading ~/.kimi/mcp.json (which may contain memo itself, causing infinite recursion).

external.name: .memo/status.json
external.description: Analysis status file read by MCP server. When status is 'analyzing', MCP responses include a warning that data may be stale.

external.name: .memo/.history
external.description: Debug log file containing MCP requests/responses and watcher events. Each line is a JSON object with seq, ts, src (mcp/watcher), type, and relevant data fields.

external.name: memo_list_keys
external.description: MCP tool that lists available keys at a path in .memo/index JSON files. Returns {type: 'dict'|'list', keys?: [...], length?: N}.

external.name: memo_get_value
external.description: MCP tool that gets the JSON value at a path in .memo/index files. Returns {value: '<JSON string>'}.

internal.name: cmd.Execute() error
internal.description: Entry point for CLI. Runs root command which dispatches to watch/scan/mcp subcommands.

internal.name: cmd.SetVersion(v string)
internal.description: Sets version string displayed in --version and banner.

internal.name: cmd.LoadConfig(path string) (*Config, error)
internal.description: Loads config from YAML file. Returns nil Config (not error) if file not found.

internal.name: analyzer.NewAnalyser(agentCfg AgentConfig, workDir string) *Analyser
internal.params: agentCfg: has APIKey and Model; workDir: project root
internal.description: Creates new Analyser. Uses embedded prompts/*.md for AI prompts.

internal.name: analyzer.Analyser.Analyse(ctx context.Context, files []string) error
internal.params: ctx: context for cancellation; files: absolute file paths
internal.description: Analyzes files in batches. Each batch: run AI prompt → validate JSON → retry up to 5x on validation failure.

internal.name: analyzer.NewWatcher(root string, ignorePatterns []string, debounce, maxWait time.Duration, onChange func([]string)) (*Watcher, error)
internal.params: root: directory to watch; ignorePatterns: glob patterns; debounce/maxWait: timing; onChange: callback
internal.description: Creates filesystem watcher with fsnotify. debounce: quiet period before triggering. maxWait: maximum delay.

internal.name: analyzer.Watcher.Flush()
internal.description: Forces immediate analysis of pending files with semaphore guard. If analysis already running, returns immediately.

internal.name: analyzer.ValidateIndex(indexDir string) (*ValidationResult, error)
internal.description: Validates all JSON files against embedded schemas. Returns detailed validation errors.

internal.name: analyzer.TryLock(memoDir string) (*os.File, error)
internal.description: Acquires exclusive lock on .memo/watcher.lock. Platform-specific: flock (Unix) or LockFileEx (Windows).

internal.name: mcp.Serve(workDir string) error
internal.description: Starts MCP server over stdio. Blocks until EOF. Handles JSON-RPC 2.0 requests.

internal.name: mcp.ParsePath(path string) (file string, segments []string, err error)
internal.description: State machine parser for JSON paths. Validates file name against allowed list, supports escape sequences.

internal.name: internal.NewHistoryLogger(memoDir, source string) (*HistoryLogger, error)
internal.description: Creates logger writing JSONL to .memo/.history. Thread-safe with sequence numbers.

internal.name: internal.CheckUpdateAsync(currentVersion string) <-chan *UpdateInfo
internal.description: Async update check via GitHub API with 2s timeout. Returns channel that receives UpdateInfo or nil.

internal.name: internal.SetLogLevel(level string)
internal.params: level: error, notice, info, or debug
internal.description: Sets global log level for LogError/LogNotice/LogInfo/LogDebug functions.
